# Ethereum Core Devs Meeting 67 Agenda

**Deadline for already submitted, non-Accepted, Istanbul EIPs to be considered "Tentatively Accepted"**

-   Meeting Date/Time:  **Friday 2 August 2019 at  [6:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc-to-germany-berlin-united-kingdom-london-ny-new-york-city-ca-san-francisco-china-shanghai-japan-tokyo-ny-new-york-city/aug-2-2019/6am)**
-   Meeting Duration 1.5 hours
-   [YouTube Live Stream](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fJd_xYnYrUU)
-   [Istanbul Meta EIP](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1679)

# Agenda

1. Istanbul EIPs 
    - Client implementation updates for Accepted and Tentatively Accepted
    - Last call for "Tentatively Accepted" EIPs
1. Conformance Testing   
1. Testnet Upgrade & Istanbul Next Steps
1. Review previous decisions made and action items
    - [Call 66](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/a0c3a021bee9ae8c6a3d7a216afd374de6c88582/All%20Core%20Devs%20Meetings/Meeting%2066.md#decisions-made)
    - [Call 65](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/All%20Core%20Devs%20Meetings/Meeting%2065.md#actions-required) 
1. [Working Group Updates](https://en.ethereum.wiki/eth1)
1.  Testing Updates
1.  Client Updates (only if they are posted in the comments below)  
    a) Geth  
    b) Parity Ethereum  
    c) Aleth/eth  
    d) Trinity/PyEVM  
    e) EthereumJS  
    f) EthereumJ/Harmony  
    g) Pantheon

1.  EWASM & Research Updates (only if they are posted in the comments below)
